sources.title: Human Interaction With Robot Swarms: A Survey
sources.retrieval_method: Agent Reach web route: Jina Reader
evidence_locations: Sections III-A, III-B and III-C; manuscript pages 5-8
supported_claims: Per-robot supervision can scale with fleet size, while task-level interaction can reduce individual management when coordination is autonomous.

sources.confidence: high for quoted/paraphrased source claims; application recommendations require AeroMesh testing

Aggregates must not conceal a disconnected relay or individually depleted vehicle. DOI: 10.1109/ICSMC.2012.6377723.

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
sources.retrieval_method: Agent Reach web route: Jina Reader
supported_claims: Color must not be the sole means of distinguishing status.

sources.confidence: high for quoted/paraphrased source claims; application recommendations require AeroMesh testing

sources.title: Age of Information: An Introduction and Survey

sources.relevance_to_aeromesh: Display state age and stale intervals independently of packet delivery latency; preserve the freshest valid source observation under out-of-order delivery.

AoI does not replace image completion deadlines or semantic validity of the received content.
HTTP modified time was not used as the publication date.
